source.text: וַיְהִ֤י הָעָם֙ כְּמִתְאֹ֣נְנִ֔ים רַ֖ע בְּאָזְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ וַיִּ֣חַר אַפּ֔וֹ וַתִּבְעַר־בָּם֙ אֵ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה וַתֹּ֖אכַל בִּקְצֵ֥ה הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And were the people like complainers [of] evil in [the] ears of Yahweh; and heard Yahweh, and burned his anger, and burned among them [the] fire of Yahweh, and consumed in [the] edge of the camp.

en.L: And the people were like those complaining [of] evil in the ears of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} heard, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger burned, and the fire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned among them and consumed [some] in the edge of the camp.
en.B: Now the people began complaining about their hardships in the hearing of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} heard it, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger flared up, and fire from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} broke out among them and burned up part of the outer edge of the camp.
en.R: The people started to complain about how hard things were, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} heard them. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} became very angry. Fire from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} began to burn among them, and it burned up some of the edge of the camp.

es.L: Y el pueblo fue como quienes se quejan [de] males a oídos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} oyó, y se encendió {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira, y el fuego {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ardió entre ellos y consumió [parte] del extremo del campamento.
es.B: Entonces el pueblo comenzó a quejarse de sus penalidades a oídos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo oyó, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira se encendió, y un fuego venido {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estalló entre ellos y consumió parte de las afueras del campamento.
es.R: El pueblo empezó a quejarse de lo dura que era su vida, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los oyó. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó mucho. Un fuego enviado por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} comenzó a arder entre ellos y quemó una parte del borde del campamento.

fr.L: Et le peuple fut comme des gens qui se plaignent [de] malheur aux oreilles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} entendit, et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère s’enflamma, et le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} brûla parmi eux et dévora [une partie de] l’extrémité du camp.
fr.B: Or le peuple se mit à se plaindre de ses malheurs aux oreilles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’entendit, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère s’enflamma, et un feu venu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} éclata parmi eux et dévora une partie de la bordure du camp.
fr.R: Le peuple a commencé à se plaindre de sa vie difficile, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a entendus. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis très en colère. Un feu envoyé par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis à brûler au milieu d’eux, et il a brûlé une partie du bord du camp.

sw.L: Na watu wakawa kama wanaonung'unika [juu ya] mabaya masikioni mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasikia, na hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ikawaka, na moto wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukawaka kati yao ukateketeza [sehemu ya] ukingo wa kambi.
sw.B: Basi watu walianza kunung'unika juu ya taabu zao masikioni mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliposikia, hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ikawaka, na moto kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukazuka kati yao, ukateketeza sehemu ya ukingo wa nje wa kambi.
sw.R: Watu walianza kulalamika kwamba maisha yao yalikuwa magumu, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawasikia. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akakasirika sana. Moto kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukaanza kuwaka kati yao, ukateketeza sehemu ya ukingo wa kambi.

vi.L: Và dân chúng giống như những kẻ than phiền [về] điều khốn khổ vào tai {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe thấy, và cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bừng lên, và lửa của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cháy giữa họ và thiêu nuốt [một phần] ở rìa trại quân.
vi.B: Bấy giờ dân chúng bắt đầu than phiền về những nỗi khó khăn của mình, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe thấy. Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe, cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bừng lên, và lửa từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bùng cháy giữa họ, thiêu rụi một phần ở rìa ngoài trại quân.
vi.R: Dân chúng bắt đầu than phiền về những nỗi vất vả của mình, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe thấy họ. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giận. Lửa từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bắt đầu cháy giữa họ và thiêu rụi một phần ở rìa khu trại.

ko.L: 그리고 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 귀에 악한 것을 불평하는 자들 같았다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 들으시고 그분의 진노가 타올랐다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 불이 그들 가운데 타올라 진 끝을 [얼마간] 삼켰다.
ko.B: 백성이 자기들이 겪는 고생에 대하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 들으시는 데서 불평하기 시작했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 소리를 들으시고 크게 진노하셨다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보내신 불이 그들 가운데 붙어 진의 바깥쪽 끝 일부를 태워 버렸다.
ko.R: 백성은 사는 것이 너무 힘들다고 불평하기 시작했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 소리를 들으셨다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 몹시 화가 나셨다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보내신 불이 그들 가운데 붙어서 진 가장자리 일부를 태워 버렸다.

pt.L: E o povo era como os que se queixam [do] mal aos ouvidos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ouviu, e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira se acendeu, e o fogo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ardeu entre eles e consumiu [uma parte] na extremidade do acampamento.
pt.B: Então o povo começou a se queixar das suas dificuldades aos ouvidos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ouviu, a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira se acendeu, e um fogo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} irrompeu entre eles e queimou parte da extremidade do acampamento.
pt.R: O povo começou a reclamar da vida difícil que levava, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ouviu. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ficou muito irado. Um fogo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} começou a queimar no meio deles e destruiu uma parte da beira do acampamento.

am.L: ሕዝቡም {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ጆሮ ስለ ክፉ ነገር እንደሚያጉረመርሙ ሆኑ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሰማ፤ ቁጣውም ነደደ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} እሳትም በመካከላቸው ነደደ፤ በሰፈሩም ዳርቻ [ያለውን] በላ።
am.B: ሕዝቡ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እየሰማ ስለ መከራቸው ማጉረምረም ጀመሩ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሰማ ጊዜ ቁጣው ነደደ፤ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} የወጣ እሳትም በመካከላቸው ተቀጣጥሎ የሰፈሩን ዳርቻ ከፊሉን አቃጠለ።
am.R: ሕዝቡ ኑሮ እንደ ከበዳቸው ማማረር ጀመሩ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሰማቸው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በጣም ተቆጣ። {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} የመጣ እሳት በመካከላቸው መንደድ ጀመረ፤ የሰፈሩንም ዳርቻ ከፊሉን አቃጠለ።

hi.L: और लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के कानों में बुराई की शिकायत करनेवालों के समान हो गए; और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने सुना, और उनका क्रोध भड़का, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आग उनके बीच जल उठी और छावनी के छोर में [कुछ] भस्म कर दिया।
hi.B: लोग अपनी कठिनाइयों के विषय में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सुनते हुए कुड़कुड़ाने लगे। जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह सुना, तो उनका क्रोध भड़क उठा, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से आग उनके बीच भड़की और छावनी के बाहरी छोर का कुछ भाग जला डाला।
hi.R: लोग शिकायत करने लगे कि उनके दिन कितने कठिन हैं, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उनकी बात सुनी। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} बहुत क्रोधित हुए। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से आग उनके बीच जलने लगी, और उसने छावनी के छोर का कुछ भाग जला दिया।

ru.L: И стал народ как бы роптать о худом в уши {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; и услышал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, и воспылал гнев {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, и разгорелся среди них огонь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и пожрал [часть] края стана.
ru.B: Народ начал роптать на свои тяготы так, что слышал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} услышал это, {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} гнев вспыхнул, и огонь от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} разгорелся среди них и сжёг часть окраины стана.
ru.R: Народ начал жаловаться на то, как ему тяжело, и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} услышал это. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сильно разгневался. Огонь от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} начал гореть среди них и сжёг часть края лагеря.

ja.L: そして民は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の耳に悪いことを言って不平を言う者のようになった。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はそれを聞いて、怒りを燃やされた。すると{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の火が彼らの中で燃え上がり、宿営の端を焼き尽くした。
ja.B: さて、民は自分たちの苦しみについて、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が聞いておられるところで不平を言い始めた。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はそれを聞いて怒りを燃え上がらせ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}からの火が彼らの中に燃え上がって、宿営の外れの一部を焼き尽くした。
ja.R: 人々は、生活がつらいと文句を言い始めました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はそれを聞かれました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はたいへん怒られました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から出た火が人々の中で燃え始め、宿営の端の一部を焼いてしまいました。

uk.L: І народ став як ті, що нарікають [на] лихо в уші {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; і почув {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і запалав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} гнів, і запалав серед них вогонь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і пожер [дещо] на краю табору.
uk.B: Народ почав нарікати на свої злидні так, що чув {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Коли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} почув це, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} гнів спалахнув, і вогонь від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} спалахнув серед них і спалив частину краю табору.
uk.R: Люди почали нарікати на те, як їм тяжко, і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} їх почув. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дуже розгнівався. Вогонь від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} почав палати серед них і спалив частину табору з краю.

decisions.choice: like complainers of evil: the people fell into grumbling about their troubles
decisions.reason: The verb for complaining is rare (elsewhere only Lamentations 3:39). "Like" can mean the people behaved as complainers, or that what they said sounded like complaint in God's hearing. "Evil" here is the hardship they complained about: the journey had just begun again (10:33), and the text does not say what troubled them.

decisions.choice: the fire of Yahweh: fire sent by Yahweh as judgment
decisions.reason: The same phrase names the fire that came from Yahweh and consumed Nadab and Abihu (Leviticus 10:2) and the 250 men who offered incense (Numbers 16:35). Here it reaches only the edge of the camp, a warning more than a destruction.

decisions.choice: consumed [some] in the edge of the camp
decisions.reason: The verb has no object; the preposition "in" means the fire ate into part of the edge of the camp. Literal brackets "some"; Balanced and Readable say "part of" and "some of".

decisions.choice: passé simple for the narrative at Literal and Balanced ("entendit", "s'enflamma"); passé composé at Readable ("a entendu"); speech in the tenses of speech at every level
decisions.reason: As the French style guide sets for narrative: the passé simple is the tense of written French narrative, the passé composé the tense of spoken French and of the plain Readable level. The complaints and Moses' prayer in this chapter are speech, so they keep the tenses of speech.

decisions.choice: "악한 것을 불평하는 자들 같았다" kept at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew comparison "like complainers of evil"; Balanced and Readable say what it means, that the people fell to grumbling about their hardships.

decisions.choice: "주께서 보내신 불" for "the fire of the LORD" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the fire as sent by the LORD in judgment; "보내신" says so with the honorific, where "주의 불" could be read as a fire belonging to him.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter (11:1, 11-23, 29)
decisions.reason: Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalizes pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans: honorific "उनका क्रोध", "क्रोधित हुए" for God
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans, as in the English
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Hindi, and the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans. Respect for God comes from the honorific third person in the narrative, and in Moses' prayers God is "तू", as the Pentateuch note settles.

decisions.choice: "कुड़कुड़ाना" (B); "शिकायत करना" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 16: Balanced uses "कुड़कुड़ाना", the word for Israel's grumbling in the wilderness, and Readable the everyday "शिकायत करना".

decisions.choice: "пожрал [часть] края стана"
decisions.reason: The verb has no object; the Hebrew "in the edge" means the fire ate into part of it. Literal brackets "часть"; Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

decisions.choice: complain (mit'onenim): "不平を言う" (L, B), "文句を言う" (R)
decisions.reason: The forms the book uses for Israel's grumbling (Exodus 15-17).

decisions.choice: The English deity_pronoun "his anger" becomes the respect form "怒りを燃やされた" / "怒られました" with no pronoun
decisions.reason: Japanese never uses 彼 for God and has no deity_pronoun spans (style §4, §7).

source.text: וַיִּצְעַ֥ק הָעָ֖ם אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֤ל מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה וַתִּשְׁקַ֖ע הָאֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And cried out the people to Moses, and prayed Moses to Yahweh, and sank the fire.

en.L: And the people cried out to Moses, and Moses prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the fire sank down.
en.B: The people cried out to Moses, and Moses prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the fire died down.
en.R: The people cried out to Moses for help. Moses prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the fire went out.

es.L: Y el pueblo clamó a Moisés, y Moisés oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y el fuego bajó.
es.B: El pueblo clamó a Moisés, Moisés oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y el fuego amainó.
es.R: El pueblo le pidió ayuda a gritos a Moisés. Moisés oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y el fuego se apagó.

fr.L: Et le peuple cria vers Moïse, et Moïse pria {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et le feu s’abaissa.
fr.B: Le peuple cria vers Moïse ; Moïse pria {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et le feu retomba.
fr.R: Le peuple a appelé Moïse au secours. Moïse a prié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et le feu s’est éteint.

sw.L: Na watu wakamlilia Musa, naye Musa akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na moto ukatulia.
sw.B: Watu walimlilia Musa, naye Musa akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na moto ukapungua.
sw.R: Watu walimlilia Musa awasaidie. Musa akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na moto ukazimika.

vi.L: Và dân chúng kêu la với Môi-se, và Môi-se cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và lửa lụi tắt.
vi.B: Dân chúng kêu cứu với Môi-se, Môi-se cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và lửa tắt dần.
vi.R: Dân chúng kêu Môi-se cứu giúp. Môi-se cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và lửa tắt.

ko.L: 그리고 백성이 모세에게 부르짖었고, 모세가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하자 불이 잦아들었다.
ko.B: 백성이 모세에게 부르짖자 모세가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도했고, 불이 사그라들었다.
ko.R: 백성은 모세에게 도와 달라고 부르짖었다. 모세가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하자 불이 꺼졌다.

pt.L: E o povo clamou a Moisés, e Moisés orou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e o fogo se abateu.
pt.B: O povo clamou a Moisés, e Moisés orou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e o fogo se apagou.
pt.R: O povo gritou a Moisés pedindo socorro. Moisés orou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e o fogo se apagou.

am.L: ሕዝቡም ወደ ሙሴ ጮኹ፤ ሙሴም {{divine_name:ወደ እግዚአብሔር|ወደ ያህዌ}} ጸለየ፤ እሳቱም ጋብ አለ።
am.B: ሕዝቡ ወደ ሙሴ ጮኹ፤ ሙሴም {{divine_name:ወደ እግዚአብሔር|ወደ ያህዌ}} ጸለየ፤ እሳቱም ጋብ አለ።
am.R: ሕዝቡ ርዳታ ለማግኘት ወደ ሙሴ ጮኹ። ሙሴም {{divine_name:ወደ እግዚአብሔር|ወደ ያህዌ}} ጸለየ፤ እሳቱም ጠፋ።

hi.L: और लोगों ने मूसा की दुहाई दी, और मूसा ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना की, और आग बुझ गई।
hi.B: लोगों ने मूसा की दुहाई दी, और मूसा ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना की, और आग धीमी पड़कर बुझ गई।
hi.R: लोगों ने मूसा को सहायता के लिए पुकारा। मूसा ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना की, और आग बुझ गई।

ru.L: И возопил народ к Моисею, и помолился Моисей {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и утих огонь.
ru.B: Народ взмолился к Моисею, и Моисей помолился {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и огонь угас.
ru.R: Народ закричал Моисею, прося о помощи. Моисей помолился {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и огонь погас.

ja.L: そして民はモーセに向かって叫んだ。そしてモーセが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈ると、火は沈んだ。
ja.B: 民はモーセに向かって叫び求めた。モーセが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈ると、火は収まった。
ja.R: 人々はモーセに助けを求めて叫びました。モーセが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈ると、火は消えました。

uk.L: І кричав народ до Мойсея, і помолився Мойсей до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і вогонь пригас.
uk.B: Народ закричав до Мойсея, і Мойсей помолився {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, і вогонь згас.
uk.R: Люди закричали до Мойсея, просячи допомоги. Мойсей помолився {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, і вогонь погас.

decisions.choice: Moses prays and the fire dies down: Moses stands between the people and God
decisions.reason: The people do not pray themselves; they cry out to Moses, and he prays for them. Moses does the same again in 12:13, 14:13-19 and 21:7.

decisions.choice: cried out to Moses for help
decisions.reason: The verb means a cry of distress. Readable adds "for help" to show what kind of cry it was.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֛א שֵֽׁם־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא תַּבְעֵרָ֑ה כִּֽי־בָעֲרָ֥ה בָ֖ם אֵ֥שׁ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And called [one] [the] name of the place the that Taberah, because burned among them [the] fire of Yahweh.

en.L: And [one] called the name of that place Taberah, because the fire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned among them.
en.B: So that place was named Taberah, because the fire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had burned among them.
en.R: So that place was called Taberah, which means "burning." It got that name because fire from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had burned among them there.

es.L: Y [se] llamó el nombre de aquel lugar Taberá, porque el fuego {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} había ardido entre ellos.
es.B: Por eso aquel lugar recibió el nombre de Taberá, porque el fuego {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} había ardido entre ellos.
es.R: Por eso a ese lugar lo llamaron Taberá, que significa «incendio». Le pusieron ese nombre porque allí el fuego {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} había ardido entre ellos.

fr.L: Et [on] appela le nom de ce lieu Tabeéra, parce que le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} avait brûlé parmi eux.
fr.B: On donna donc à ce lieu le nom de Tabeéra, parce que le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} avait brûlé parmi eux.
fr.R: C’est pourquoi on a appelé cet endroit Tabeéra, ce qui veut dire « incendie ». Il a reçu ce nom parce que le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} avait brûlé là, au milieu d’eux.

sw.L: Na [mtu] akaliita jina la mahali pale Tabera, kwa sababu moto wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uliwaka kati yao.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo mahali pale paliitwa Tabera, kwa sababu moto wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulikuwa umewaka kati yao.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo mahali pale paliitwa Tabera, maana yake "Kuwaka moto." Palipewa jina hilo kwa sababu moto kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulikuwa umewaka kati yao pale.

vi.L: Và [người ta] gọi tên nơi ấy là Tha-bê-ra, vì lửa của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cháy giữa họ.
vi.B: Vì vậy nơi ấy được gọi là Tha-bê-ra, vì lửa của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cháy giữa họ.
vi.R: Vì vậy nơi ấy được gọi là Tha-bê-ra, nghĩa là "đám cháy". Nơi ấy có tên như vậy vì lửa từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cháy giữa họ tại đó.

ko.L: 그리고 [사람들이] 그곳의 이름을 다베라라고 불렀다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 불이 그들 가운데 타올랐기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그래서 그곳의 이름을 다베라라고 했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 불이 그들 가운데 타올랐기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그래서 그곳을 다베라라고 불렀다. 다베라는 "불탐"이라는 뜻이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보내신 불이 거기서 그들 가운데 타올랐기 때문에 그런 이름이 붙었다.

pt.L: E chamou-se o nome daquele lugar Taberá, porque o fogo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tinha ardido entre eles.
pt.B: Por isso aquele lugar recebeu o nome de Taberá, porque o fogo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tinha ardido entre eles.
pt.R: Por isso aquele lugar ficou com o nome de Taberá, que quer dizer "incêndio". Recebeu esse nome porque o fogo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tinha queimado ali no meio deles.

am.L: [ሰውም] የዚያን ስፍራ ስም ተቤራ ብሎ ጠራው፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} እሳት በመካከላቸው ነድዶ ነበርና።
am.B: ስለዚህ ያ ስፍራ ተቤራ ተባለ፤ ትርጉሙም መቃጠል ነው፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} እሳት በመካከላቸው ነድዶ ነበርና።
am.R: ስለዚህ ያ ስፍራ ተቤራ ተባለ፤ ትርጉሙም «መቃጠል» ማለት ነው። ይህን ስም ያገኘው {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} የመጣ እሳት በዚያ በመካከላቸው ስለ ነደደ ነው።

hi.L: और [किसी ने] उस जगह का नाम तबेरा रखा, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आग उनके बीच जल उठी थी।
hi.B: इसलिए उस जगह का नाम तबेरा पड़ा, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आग उनके बीच जल उठी थी।
hi.R: इसलिए उस जगह का नाम तबेरा पड़ा, जिसका अर्थ है "जलन"। उसका यह नाम इसलिए पड़ा कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से आई आग वहाँ उनके बीच जली थी।

ru.L: И нарекли имя тому месту Тавера, потому что разгорелся среди них огонь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Поэтому то место назвали Тавера, потому что среди них разгорелся огонь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Поэтому то место назвали Тавера, что значит «пожар». Оно получило такое имя, потому что огонь от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} горел там среди них.

ja.L: そして[人々は]その場所の名をタブエラと呼んだ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の火が彼らの中で燃えたからである。
ja.B: それで、その場所はタブエラと名づけられた。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の火が彼らの中で燃えたからである。
ja.R: それで、その場所はタブエラと呼ばれるようになりました。タブエラは「燃える」という意味です。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から出た火が、そこで人々の中で燃えたので、その名前がつけられたのです。

uk.L: І назвали імʼя того місця Тавера, бо запалав серед них вогонь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Тож те місце назвали Тавера, бо там серед них палав вогонь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Тож те місце назвали Тавера, що означає «пожежа». Воно дістало цю назву, бо там серед них палав вогонь від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: Taberah: "burning", a name taken from what happened there
decisions.reason: The place name comes from the same root as the verb "burned" in this verse and in verse 1. The place appears again in the list of Israel's offenses in Deuteronomy 9:22. It is not in the list of camps in Numbers 33, so it may be a spot near the camp at Kibroth-hattaavah (verse 34) rather than a separate stop.

decisions.choice: called: someone named it; the subject is left unstated
decisions.reason: The verb is singular with no subject, the Hebrew way of saying "it was named". It may mean Moses or the people in general.

decisions.choice: which means "burning"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name, since the story turns on its meaning.

decisions.choice: "다베라" kept as the name at every level; Readable adds its meaning, "불탐"
decisions.reason: As the Genesis sheet sets for names that are explained, the name stays and Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does. The place names of this chapter are 다베라, 기브롯 핫다아와 and 하세롯, the usual Protestant forms.

decisions.choice: chamou-se o nome daquele lugar
decisions.reason: The verb has no subject (m2). Portuguese says this with the impersonal "chamou-se", so Literal needs no bracketed "one"; the enclitic is the written form for a verb that cannot open with a pronoun.

decisions.choice: Taberá, que quer dizer "incêndio"
decisions.reason: "Taberá" is the usual Brazilian form. Readable explains the name with "incêndio", a fire that burns, the sense of the root shared with "ardeu" in verse 1; "queimada" in Brazil means burning off a field.

decisions.choice: The meaning of the name is given at Balanced ("ትርጉሙም መቃጠል ነው", without quotation marks) and Readable ("ትርጉሙም «መቃጠል» ማለት ነው"); so for Kibroth-hattaavah in 11:34
alternatives: explaining the name at Readable only, as the English does
decisions.reason: As settled for Genesis and Exodus: an Amharic reader cannot hear the Hebrew pun, so Balanced explains it too. Balanced gives the meaning without quotation marks so that its quotations stay those of the English Balanced.

decisions.choice: "जिसका अर्थ है "जलन"" (which means "burning")
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, Readable explains the name, since the story turns on it.

decisions.choice: "Тавера"; «пожар» (R)
decisions.reason: The place names of this chapter take their traditional Russian forms (Тавера, Кивроф-Гаттаава, Асироф). Readable explains Taberah as "пожар" (burning), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Taberah "タブエラ"; Readable explains it as 「燃える」, keeping the English quotation marks as a bracket pair
decisions.reason: A transcription of the Hebrew name; the explanation follows the English Readable, which marks the meaning as a quotation.

decisions.choice: place names transcribed from the Hebrew: "Тавера", "Ківрот-Гаттаава", "Хацерот"
decisions.reason: Place names in the wilderness are transcribed with в for b after a vowel, г for h and ц for ts, as the shared terms set; Readable gives the meaning of a name where the English does.

source.text: וְהָֽאסַפְסֻף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ הִתְאַוּ֖וּ תַּאֲוָ֑ה וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ וַיִּבְכּ֗וּ גַּ֚ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מִ֥י יַאֲכִלֵ֖נוּ בָּשָֽׂר׃

records.literal_gloss: And the rabble that [was] in its midst craved a craving, and returned and wept also [the] sons of Israel, and said, who will feed us meat?

en.L: And the rabble that [was] among them craved a craving, and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel also wept again, and said, "Who will feed us meat?
en.B: The mixed crowd among them was seized by craving, and the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} began to weep again too. They said, "If only we had meat to eat!
en.R: The outsiders who were traveling with the people began to long for better food. Then the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} started crying again too. They said, "We wish we had meat to eat!

es.L: Y el populacho que [estaba] en medio de ellos ardió en deseo, y también los hijos de Israel volvieron a llorar, y dijeron: «¿Quién nos dará a comer carne?
es.B: La multitud mezclada que iba con ellos se dejó dominar por el antojo, y también los israelitas volvieron a llorar. Decían: «¡Si al menos tuviéramos carne para comer!
es.R: Los extranjeros que viajaban con el pueblo empezaron a desear una comida mejor. Entonces los israelitas también se pusieron a llorar otra vez. Decían: «¡Cómo nos gustaría comer carne!

fr.L: Et le ramassis qui [était] au milieu d’eux fut pris de convoitise, et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël aussi se remirent à pleurer, et dirent : « Qui nous fera manger de la viande ?
fr.B: La foule mélangée qui était parmi eux fut saisie d’une envie violente, et les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} se mirent eux aussi à pleurer de nouveau. Ils disaient : « Si seulement nous avions de la viande à manger !
fr.R: Les gens venus d’ailleurs qui voyageaient avec le peuple ont commencé à avoir très envie d’une meilleure nourriture. Alors les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} se sont remis à pleurer, eux aussi. Ils disaient : « Comme nous aimerions manger de la viande !

sw.L: Na kundi la watu waliokusanyika lililokuwa katikati yao likatamani kwa tamaa kubwa, nao wana wa Israeli pia wakalia tena, wakasema, "Ni nani atakayetulisha nyama?
sw.B: Mchanganyiko wa watu waliokuwa pamoja nao ulishikwa na tamaa kubwa, nao Waisraeli wakaanza kulia tena. Wakasema, "Laiti tungekuwa na nyama ya kula!
sw.R: Wageni waliokuwa wakisafiri pamoja na watu walianza kutamani chakula kizuri zaidi. Kisha Waisraeli nao wakaanza kulia tena. Wakasema, "Tungependa sana kupata nyama ya kula!

vi.L: Và đám người hỗn tạp [ở] giữa họ thèm muốn một cách thèm khát, và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên cũng lại khóc lóc và nói: "Ai sẽ cho chúng ta ăn thịt?
vi.B: Đám người hỗn tạp ở giữa họ nổi lòng thèm khát, và dân Y-sơ-ra-ên cũng lại bắt đầu khóc lóc. Họ nói: "Ước gì chúng ta có thịt mà ăn!
vi.R: Những người ngoại quốc đi theo dân chúng bắt đầu thèm thức ăn ngon hơn. Rồi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên cũng lại khóc lóc. Họ nói: "Ước gì chúng ta có thịt để ăn!

ko.L: 그리고 그들 가운데 있던 섞여 사는 무리가 탐욕을 품어 탐하였고, 이스라엘 자손도 다시 울며 말하였다. "누가 우리에게 고기를 먹여 줄까?
ko.B: 그들 가운데 섞여 있던 무리가 탐욕에 사로잡히자, 이스라엘 백성도 다시 울며 말했다. "고기를 먹을 수 있으면 좋겠다!
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성과 함께 다니던 다른 민족 사람들이 더 좋은 음식을 몹시 먹고 싶어 했다. 그러자 이스라엘 사람들도 다시 울기 시작하며 말했다. "고기를 먹을 수 있으면 좋겠다!

pt.L: E a turba que [estava] no meio deles foi tomada de desejo intenso, e também os filhos de Israel voltaram a chorar, e disseram: "Quem nos dará carne para comer?
pt.B: A mistura de gente que estava no meio deles foi tomada de um desejo intenso, e os israelitas também voltaram a chorar. Eles diziam: "Quem dera tivéssemos carne para comer!
pt.R: Os estrangeiros que viajavam com o povo começaram a desejar comida melhor. Então os israelitas também começaram a chorar de novo. Eles diziam: "Como queríamos ter carne para comer!

am.L: በመካከላቸውም የነበረው የተቀላቀለ ሕዝብ ምኞትን ተመኘ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ደግሞ ተመልሰው አለቀሱ፤ እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ሥጋ የሚያበላን ማን ነው?
am.B: በመካከላቸው የነበረው የተቀላቀለ ሕዝብ በብርቱ ምኞት ተያዘ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆችም እንደ ገና ማልቀስ ጀመሩ። እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ምነው የምንበላው ሥጋ ባገኘን!

hi.L: और उनके बीच जो भीड़-भाड़ [थी], उसने लालसा की लालसा की, और {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्र}} भी फिर रोने लगे और कहा, "हमें मांस कौन खिलाएगा?
hi.B: उनके बीच रहनेवाली मिली-जुली भीड़ लालसा से भर गई, और इस्राएली भी फिर रोने लगे। वे कहने लगे, "काश, हमें खाने को मांस मिलता!
hi.R: जो परदेशी लोग इस्राएलियों के साथ यात्रा कर रहे थे, वे अच्छे भोजन के लिए तरसने लगे। तब इस्राएली भी फिर से रोने लगे। वे कहने लगे, "काश, हमें खाने के लिए मांस मिलता!

ru.L: А сброд, который [был] среди них, предался прихоти, и снова заплакали и {{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}}, и сказали: «Кто накормит нас мясом?
ru.B: Разношёрстный народ, бывший среди них, охватила жадная прихоть, и израильтяне тоже снова заплакали. Они говорили: «Вот бы нам поесть мяса!
ru.R: Чужаки, которые шли вместе с народом, захотели лучшей еды. Тогда и израильтяне снова начали плакать. Они говорили: «Хоть бы нам поесть мяса!

ja.L: そして彼らの中にいた寄せ集めの者たちは激しい欲望を抱いた。そしてイスラエルの子らも再び泣いて言った。「だれがわたしたちに肉を食べさせてくれるだろうか？
ja.B: 彼らの中に混じっていた人々は激しい欲望にとらわれ、イスラエルの人々もまた泣き出して言った。「ああ、肉が食べられたらよいのに。
ja.R: 人々と一緒に旅をしていたほかの国の人たちが、もっとおいしい物を食べたいと思うようになりました。すると、イスラエルの人々もまた泣き出して言いました。「肉が食べたい。

uk.L: А збіговисько, що [було] серед них, запрагло жаги, і також {{gender:нащадки Ізраїля|сини Ізраїля}} знову заплакали і сказали: «Хто нагодує нас мʼясом?
uk.B: Збіговисько людей серед них охопила жадоба, і ізраїльтяни теж знову заплакали. Вони казали: «Якби нам мʼяса поїсти!
uk.R: Чужі люди, що йшли разом із народом, почали прагнути кращої їжі. Тоді й ізраїльтяни знову заплакали. Вони казали: «Нам би мʼяса поїсти!

decisions.choice: the rabble: a gathered mob, probably the non-Israelites who left Egypt with Israel
decisions.reason: The word appears only here. It comes from a verb meaning "gather" and suggests a collection of people, a crowd brought together from anywhere. The verse sets them apart from "the sons of Israel also", so they are most likely the "mixed crowd" that went up from Egypt with Israel (Exodus 12:38).

decisions.choice: craved a craving: a strong, consuming desire
decisions.reason: The verb and its noun from the same root stress the strength of the desire. The same word gives the place its name in verse 34, "graves of craving".

decisions.choice: who will feed us meat?: a wish, not a real question
decisions.reason: "Who will ...?" is a Hebrew way of saying "if only someone would ..." (as in 2 Samuel 23:15). The people are not asking who will provide meat; they are complaining that they have none.

decisions.choice: returned and wept: wept again
decisions.reason: "Returned" before another verb means the act happened again. Israel had complained about food before, in the wilderness of Sin (Exodus 16:2-3), where God gave both quail and manna.

decisions.choice: the mixed crowd (Balanced); the outsiders who were traveling with the people (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the phrase that links this group to Exodus 12:38; Readable says plainly who they probably were. Literal keeps "rabble", the sense of the word itself.

decisions.choice: "el populacho" for the rabble
decisions.reason: "Populacho" names a disorderly mass of people and keeps the scorn of the Hebrew word; "chusma" is harsher and more colloquial. Balanced follows the English link to Exodus 12:38 ("la multitud mezclada").

decisions.choice: "le ramassis" for the rabble
decisions.reason: "Ramassis" is a heap of things or people gathered from anywhere, close to the root of the Hebrew word ("gather"), and it carries the same scorn. Balanced and Readable follow the English ("la foule mélangée", as in Exodus 12:38; "les gens venus d'ailleurs").

decisions.choice: "kundi la watu waliokusanyika" (a crowd of people gathered together) for the rabble
decisions.reason: Swahili has no single word for a mob collected from anywhere, so Literal spells out the root sense of the word ("gather"). Balanced uses "mchanganyiko wa watu", the phrase of Exodus 12:38 ("mixed crowd").

decisions.choice: "đám người hỗn tạp" (L, B); R "những người ngoại quốc đi theo dân chúng"
decisions.reason: A neutral phrase for the gathered crowd; Readable says who they probably were, as the English Readable does and the footnoted meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "섞여 사는 무리" (Literal), "섞여 있던 무리" (Balanced), "함께 다니던 다른 민족 사람들" (Readable) for the rabble
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as a gathered crowd, probably the non-Israelites who left Egypt with Israel (Exodus 12:38); the Korean says this without the scorn of "잡족". Readable says who they were, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "고기를 먹을 수 있으면 좋겠다!" for "Who will feed us meat?" at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps the question
decisions.reason: The question is a wish, as the meaning decision says; the people speak among themselves in the plain style.

decisions.choice: a turba (L); a mistura de gente (B); os estrangeiros que viajavam com o povo (R); desejo intenso
decisions.reason: "Turba" is a crowd gathered from anywhere (m1), without the class insult of "ralé". Balanced says "mistura de gente", the phrase of Exodus 12:38 in Portuguese. "Desejo" is kept for the root so that the name in verse 34, "sepulturas do desejo", can be explained with the same word.

decisions.choice: "የተቀላቀለ ሕዝብ" (the mixed people) for the rabble; "ምኞትን ተመኘ" (craved a craving) at Literal
alternatives: "ድብልቅ ሕዝብ", the term for the mixed multitude of Exodus 12:38
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word here is a different one from Exodus 12:38, a gathered crowd (m1), so the Exodus term is not reused. Literal keeps the doubled verb and noun.

decisions.choice: "भीड़-भाड़" (L); "मिली-जुली भीड़" (B); "जो परदेशी लोग ... साथ यात्रा कर रहे थे" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means a gathered mob, probably the non-Israelites who left Egypt with Israel (m1). Balanced uses the phrase that ties them to the mixed crowd of Exodus 12:38; Readable says who they probably were.

decisions.choice: "लालसा की लालसा की" (craved a craving)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew doubling of noun and verb, which marks a strong, consuming desire (m2).

decisions.choice: "сброд" (L); "разношёрстный народ" (B); "чужаки, которые шли вместе с народом" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the sense of the word itself, a gathered mob; Balanced links the group to the mixed crowd of Exodus 12:38; Readable says who they probably were. The B and R wishes render "Who will feed us meat?" as the wish it is (m3).

decisions.choice: the rabble (asafsuf): "寄せ集めの者たち" (L), "混じっていた人々" (B), "一緒に旅をしていたほかの国の人たち" (R)
alternatives: "入り混じった大勢の群衆" (Exodus 12:38, another word)
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1: a gathered mob, probably the non-Israelites; each level says as much as its English.

decisions.choice: who will feed us meat?: a wish at Balanced and Readable ("肉が食べられたらよいのに", "肉が食べたい"), a question at Literal
alternatives: "だれが肉を食べさせてくれるのか？" at every level
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m3: a wish, not a real question; Literal keeps the Hebrew form, without ？ since nothing is really asked.

decisions.choice: "збіговисько" (L, B), "чужі люди, що йшли разом із народом" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a gathered rabble, most likely the non-Israelites who left Egypt with Israel; "збіговисько" keeps the slight contempt without being coarse, and Readable says who they were, as the English does.

source.text: זָכַ֨רְנוּ֙ אֶת־הַדָּגָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נֹאכַ֥ל בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם חִנָּ֑ם אֵ֣ת הַקִּשֻּׁאִ֗ים וְאֵת֙ הָֽאֲבַטִּחִ֔ים וְאֶת־הֶחָצִ֥יר וְאֶת־הַבְּצָלִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַשּׁוּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: We remember the fish which we ate in Egypt for nothing, the cucumbers and the melons and the leeks and the onions and the garlic.

en.L: We remember the fish that we ate in Egypt for nothing, the cucumbers and the melons and the leeks and the onions and the garlic.
en.B: We remember the fish we used to eat in Egypt at no cost, and the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions and the garlic.
en.R: We remember all the fish we ate in Egypt. It did not cost us anything! We also had cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions and garlic.

es.L: Nos acordamos del pescado que comíamos en Egipto gratis, de los pepinos y de los melones y de los puerros y de las cebollas y de los ajos.
es.B: Recordamos el pescado que comíamos en Egipto sin pagar nada, y los pepinos, los melones, los puerros, las cebollas y los ajos.
es.R: Nos acordamos de todo el pescado que comíamos en Egipto. ¡No nos costaba nada! También teníamos pepinos, melones, puerros, cebollas y ajos.

fr.L: Nous nous souvenons du poisson que nous mangions en Égypte pour rien, des concombres et des melons et des poireaux et des oignons et de l’ail.
fr.B: Nous nous rappelons le poisson que nous mangions en Égypte sans rien payer, et les concombres, les melons, les poireaux, les oignons et l’ail.
fr.R: Nous nous souvenons de tous les poissons que nous mangions en Égypte. Ils ne nous coûtaient rien ! Nous avions aussi des concombres, des melons, des poireaux, des oignons et de l’ail.

sw.L: Tunawakumbuka samaki tuliowala Misri bure, matango na matikiti na vitunguu majani na vitunguu na vitunguu saumu.
sw.B: Tunawakumbuka samaki tuliokuwa tukiwala huko Misri bila kulipa chochote, pamoja na matango, matikiti, vitunguu majani, vitunguu na vitunguu saumu.
sw.R: Tunawakumbuka samaki wengi tuliowala huko Misri. Hatukulipa chochote! Tulikuwa pia na matango, matikiti, vitunguu majani, vitunguu na vitunguu saumu.

vi.L: Chúng ta nhớ cá mà chúng ta đã ăn không tốn tiền ở Ai Cập, dưa chuột và dưa gang, tỏi tây, hành và tỏi.
vi.B: Chúng ta còn nhớ cá mình được ăn ở Ai Cập mà chẳng tốn đồng nào, cùng với dưa chuột, dưa gang, tỏi tây, hành và tỏi.
vi.R: Chúng ta nhớ biết bao nhiêu là cá mình đã ăn ở Ai Cập. Chẳng tốn đồng nào cả! Chúng ta cũng có dưa chuột, dưa gang, tỏi tây, hành và tỏi.

ko.L: 우리가 이집트에서 공짜로 먹던 생선과 오이와 수박과 부추와 양파와 마늘이 기억난다.
ko.B: 우리가 이집트에서 값없이 먹던 생선이 생각난다. 오이와 수박과 부추와 양파와 마늘도 생각난다.
ko.R: 이집트에서 먹던 그 많은 생선이 생각난다. 그때는 돈 한 푼 들지 않았지! 오이와 수박과 부추와 양파와 마늘도 있었다.

pt.L: Nós nos lembramos do peixe que comíamos no Egito de graça, dos pepinos, e dos melões, e dos alhos-porós, e das cebolas, e dos alhos.
pt.B: Nós nos lembramos do peixe que comíamos de graça no Egito, e dos pepinos, dos melões, dos alhos-porós, das cebolas e dos alhos.
pt.R: Nós nos lembramos de todo o peixe que comíamos no Egito. Não pagávamos nada por ele! E também havia pepinos, melões, alhos-porós, cebolas e alhos.

am.L: በግብፅ በነጻ የበላነውን ዓሣ፣ ዱባውንና ሐብሐቡን፣ ባሮ ሽንኩርቱንና ቀይ ሽንኩርቱን፣ ነጭ ሽንኩርቱንም እናስታውሳለን።

am.R: በግብፅ የበላነውን ዓሣ ሁሉ እናስታውሳለን። ምንም አላስከፈለንም! ዱባ፣ ሐብሐብ፣ ባሮ ሽንኩርት፣ ቀይ ሽንኩርትና ነጭ ሽንኩርትም ነበረን።

hi.L: हम उस मछली को स्मरण करते हैं जो हम मिस्र में सेंत-मेंत खाते थे, और खीरे और ख़रबूज़े और गंदने और प्याज़ और लहसुन।
hi.B: हमें वह मछली याद आती है जो हम मिस्र में मुफ़्त खाया करते थे, और वे खीरे, ख़रबूज़े, गंदने, प्याज़ और लहसुन भी।
hi.R: हमें मिस्र की वह सारी मछली याद आती है जो हम खाते थे। उसके लिए हमें कुछ नहीं देना पड़ता था! वहाँ हमारे पास खीरे, ख़रबूज़े, गंदने, प्याज़ और लहसुन भी थे।

ru.L: Помним мы рыбу, которую ели в Египте даром, огурцы, и дыни, и лук-порей, и лук, и чеснок.
ru.B: Мы помним рыбу, которую даром ели в Египте, и огурцы, и дыни, и лук-порей, и лук, и чеснок.
ru.R: Мы помним, сколько рыбы мы ели в Египте. Она нам ничего не стоила! А ещё у нас были огурцы, дыни, лук-порей, лук и чеснок.

ja.L: わたしたちは、エジプトでただで食べていた魚を覚えている。きゅうりも、うりも、ねぎも、玉ねぎも、にんにくも。
ja.B: エジプトでは魚をただで食べていたことを思い出す。きゅうりも、うりも、ねぎも、玉ねぎも、にんにくもあった。
ja.R: エジプトでは、魚をたくさん食べたなあ。お金なんか、ちっともかからなかった。きゅうりも、うりも、ねぎも、玉ねぎも、にんにくもあった。

uk.L: Ми памʼятаємо рибу, яку їли в Єгипті задарма, огірки, і дині, і порей, і цибулю, і часник.
uk.B: Ми памʼятаємо рибу, яку задарма їли в Єгипті, і огірки, і дині, і порей, і цибулю, і часник.
uk.R: Ми памʼятаємо, скільки риби ми їли в Єгипті. Вона нам нічого не коштувала! У нас були також огірки, дині, порей, цибуля й часник.

decisions.choice: for nothing: free, without paying
decisions.reason: The word means "without cost". The Nile gave plenty of fish (Exodus 7:18, 21; Isaiah 19:8), and the people remember it as food they did not have to pay for. They forget that in Egypt they were slaves whose labor was the price (Exodus 1:13-14).

decisions.choice: cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, garlic: the vegetables of the Nile valley
decisions.reason: These are the common foods of Egypt. Each word appears only here in the Bible, except "leeks", which is usually the word for grass or green plants. The plants meant are well known from Egypt, though the exact kinds cannot always be fixed: "melons" may be watermelons.

decisions.choice: "vitunguu majani" (leeks), "vitunguu" (onions), "vitunguu saumu" (garlic)
decisions.reason: Swahili names all three plants of the onion family with "vitunguu"; "vitunguu majani" (leaf onions) is the usual word for leeks and green onions, and keeps the three foods distinct.

decisions.choice: "수박" for the melons
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names a large melon of the Nile valley, most likely the watermelon, which was grown in ancient Egypt; "참외" is a Korean melon the Hebrew does not mean.

decisions.choice: "गंदना" (leek)
decisions.reason: "गंदना" is the Hindi name of the leek, a plant like the onion; the five vegetables are those of the Nile valley (m2).

decisions.choice: cucumbers "きゅうり", melons "うり", leeks "ねぎ", onions "玉ねぎ", garlic "にんにく"
alternatives: "すいか" or "メロン" for avattichim
decisions.reason: Everyday kana names; "うり" covers the melon family without naming one kind.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֛ה נַפְשֵׁ֥נוּ יְבֵשָׁ֖ה אֵ֣ין כֹּ֑ל בִּלְתִּ֖י אֶל־הַמָּ֥ן עֵינֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now our soul [is] dry; there is not anything except to the manna our eyes.

en.L: But now our soul [is] dried up; there is nothing at all except the manna before our eyes."
en.B: But now we are wasting away. There is nothing at all, and all we ever see is this manna!"
en.R: But now we have no strength left. There is nothing to eat. All we ever see is this manna!"

es.L: Pero ahora nuestra alma [está] reseca; no hay nada en absoluto, sino el maná ante nuestros ojos».
es.B: Pero ahora nos estamos consumiendo. No hay nada de nada, ¡y lo único que vemos es este maná!»
es.R: Pero ahora ya no tenemos fuerzas. No hay nada para comer. ¡Lo único que vemos siempre es este maná!»

fr.L: Mais maintenant notre âme [est] desséchée ; il n’y a rien du tout, sinon la manne devant nos yeux. »
fr.B: Mais maintenant, nous dépérissons. Il n’y a plus rien du tout, et nous ne voyons jamais que cette manne ! »
fr.R: Mais maintenant, nous n’avons plus de forces. Il n’y a rien à manger. Tout ce que nous voyons, c’est cette manne ! »

sw.L: Lakini sasa nafsi yetu imekauka; hakuna kitu chochote, ila mana mbele ya macho yetu."
sw.B: Lakini sasa tunadhoofika. Hakuna kitu chochote, na tunachokiona tu ni mana hiki!"
sw.R: Lakini sasa hatuna nguvu tena. Hakuna chakula. Hatuoni kitu kingine ila mana hiki!"

vi.L: Nhưng bây giờ linh hồn chúng ta khô héo; chẳng có gì cả ngoài ma-na trước mắt chúng ta."
vi.B: Nhưng bây giờ chúng ta héo hon cả người. Chẳng có gì hết, ngày nào cũng chỉ thấy ma-na này!"
vi.R: Nhưng bây giờ chúng ta chẳng còn chút sức lực nào. Không có gì để ăn cả. Lúc nào cũng chỉ thấy ma-na này!"

ko.L: 그런데 이제 우리 목숨이 말라 버렸다. 이 만나 말고는 우리 눈앞에 아무것도 없다."
ko.B: 그런데 이제 우리는 기운이 다 빠졌다. 아무것도 없고, 보이는 것이라고는 이 만나뿐이다!"
ko.R: 그런데 이제 우리는 힘이 하나도 없다. 먹을 것이 아무것도 없다. 날마다 보이는 것은 이 만나뿐이다!"

pt.L: Mas agora a nossa alma [está] seca; não há nada, a não ser o maná diante dos nossos olhos."
pt.B: Mas agora estamos definhando. Não há nada, e tudo o que vemos é este maná!"
pt.R: Mas agora não temos mais forças. Não há nada para comer. Tudo o que vemos é este maná!"

am.L: አሁን ግን ነፍሳችን ደርቃለች፤ ከዚህ መና በቀር በዓይናችን ፊት ምንም የለም።»
am.B: አሁን ግን ሰውነታችን ከሳ፤ ምንም ነገር የለም፤ የምናየው ይህን መና ብቻ ነው!»
am.R: አሁን ግን ምንም ጉልበት አልቀረልንም። የሚበላ ምንም ነገር የለም። ሁልጊዜ የምናየው ይህን መና ብቻ ነው!»

hi.L: परंतु अब हमारा प्राण सूख गया [है]; हमारी आँखों के सामने इस मन्ना को छोड़ कुछ भी नहीं है।"
hi.B: परंतु अब हम सूखते जा रहे हैं। कुछ भी नहीं है, और हमें जो कुछ दिखता है वह बस यही मन्ना है!"
hi.R: परंतु अब हममें कोई ताक़त नहीं रही। खाने को कुछ भी नहीं है। हमें बस यही मन्ना दिखाई देता है!"

ru.L: А теперь душа наша иссохла; нет ничего, кроме манны перед глазами нашими.»
ru.B: А теперь мы совсем истощены. Нет ничего, и мы видим только эту манну!»
ru.R: А теперь у нас не осталось сил. Есть нечего. Мы видим одну только эту манну!»

ja.L: しかし今、わたしたちの喉は干からびている。何もない。わたしたちの目の前にはこのマナしかない。」
ja.B: しかし今、わたしたちは弱り果てている。何もない。見えるのはこのマナばかりだ。」
ja.R: でも今は、もう力が出ない。食べ物が何もない。目に入るのは、このマナだけだ。」

uk.L: А тепер наша душа висохла; немає нічого, крім манни перед нашими очима.»
uk.B: А тепер ми виснажуємося. Немає нічого, і бачимо ми тільки цю манну!»
uk.R: А тепер у нас не лишилося сили. Їсти нічого. Ми бачимо тільки цю манну!»

decisions.choice: our soul is dried up: we are withered, our strength is drained
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word often translated "soul" can mean the throat, the appetite or a person's life. "Dried up" pictures a plant withering. The people mean they are wasting away for lack of real food, though the phrase could also mean they have lost their appetite.

decisions.choice: nothing at all except the manna before our eyes
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is short and abrupt: "nothing at all, except to the manna our eyes". It means that the manna is all they ever see. Manna is the food God gave from heaven each morning (Exodus 16:14-15, 35).

decisions.choice: we are wasting away / we have no strength left
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the picture. Literal keeps "our soul is dried up".

decisions.choice: "हमारा प्राण सूख गया" (L); "हम सूखते जा रहे हैं" (B); "हममें कोई ताक़त नहीं रही" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, Balanced the image of withering, Readable its sense (m1). "मन्ना" is the form of Exodus 16:31.

decisions.choice: our nefesh is dried up: "わたしたちの喉は干からびている" (L), "弱り果てている" (B), "力が出ない" (R)
alternatives: "わたしたちの魂は干からびている"
decisions.reason: Nefesh here is the craving self, with the sense of throat and appetite; "魂" would make the complaint sound spiritual (meaning decision m1, uncertain).

source.text: וְהַמָּ֕ן כִּזְרַע־גַּ֖ד ה֑וּא וְעֵינ֖וֹ כְּעֵ֥ין הַבְּדֹֽלַח׃

records.literal_gloss: And the manna like seed of coriander [was] it, and its appearance like [the] appearance of the bdellium.

en.L: And the manna, it [was] like coriander seed, and its appearance [was] like the appearance of bdellium.
en.B: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.
en.R: The manna was shaped like little coriander seeds. It was the color of a pale, clear gum called bdellium.

es.L: Y el maná, este [era] como semilla de cilantro, y su aspecto [era] como el aspecto del bedelio.
es.B: El maná era como semilla de cilantro, y tenía el aspecto del bedelio.
es.R: El maná tenía la forma de semillitas de cilantro. Tenía el color de una resina pálida y transparente llamada bedelio.

fr.L: Or la manne, elle [était] comme de la graine de coriandre, et son aspect [était] comme l’aspect du bdellium.
fr.B: La manne ressemblait à de la graine de coriandre, et elle avait l’aspect du bdellium.
fr.R: La manne avait la forme de petites graines de coriandre. Elle avait la couleur d’une gomme pâle et transparente, appelée bdellium.

sw.L: Na mana, hicho [kilikuwa] kama mbegu za giligilani, na sura yake [ilikuwa] kama sura ya bedola.
sw.B: Mana kilikuwa kama mbegu za giligilani, na kilionekana kama bedola.
sw.R: Mana kilikuwa na umbo la mbegu ndogo za giligilani. Rangi yake ilikuwa kama ya utomvu uliofifia na unaong'aa, uitwao bedola.

vi.L: Và ma-na, nó [giống] như hạt ngò, và hình dạng nó [giống] như hình dạng nhựa thơm.
vi.B: Ma-na giống như hạt ngò, và trông giống như nhựa thơm.
vi.R: Ma-na có hình dạng như những hạt ngò nhỏ. Nó có màu như một loại nhựa cây trong và nhạt màu gọi là nhựa thơm.

ko.L: 그리고 만나, 그것은 고수 씨 같았고, 그 모양은 베델리엄의 모양 같았다.
ko.B: 만나는 고수 씨처럼 생겼고, 빛깔은 베델리엄 같았다.
ko.R: 만나는 작은 고수 씨처럼 생겼다. 빛깔은 베델리엄이라는 연하고 맑은 나뭇진과 같았다.

pt.L: E o maná, ele [era] como semente de coentro, e a sua aparência [era] como a aparência do bdélio.
pt.B: O maná era como semente de coentro e tinha a aparência do bdélio.
pt.R: O maná tinha a forma de pequenas sementes de coentro. Tinha a cor de uma resina clara chamada bdélio.

am.L: መናውም እንደ ድንብላል ዘር ነበረ፤ መልኩም እንደ ቤዶላሕ መልክ ነበረ።
am.B: መናው እንደ ድንብላል ዘር ነበረ፤ መልኩም ቤዶላሕ የተባለውን ሙጫ ይመስል ነበር።
am.R: መናው ትንንሽ የድንብላል ዘሮችን ይመስል ነበር። ቀለሙም ቤዶላሕ የተባለውን ፈዛዛና ጥርት ያለ ሙጫ ይመስል ነበር።

hi.L: और मन्ना, वह धनिये के बीज के समान [था], और उसका रूप बदोलह के रूप के समान [था]।
hi.B: मन्ना धनिये के बीज जैसा था, और वह बदोलह जैसा दिखता था।
hi.R: मन्ना धनिये के छोटे बीजों जैसा था। उसका रंग बदोलह नाम के एक हल्के रंग के, साफ़ गोंद जैसा था।

ru.L: А манна — как семя кориандра она, и вид её как вид бдолаха.
ru.B: Манна была похожа на семена кориандра, а видом напоминала бдолах.
ru.R: Манна была похожа на маленькие семена кориандра. Цветом она напоминала светлую прозрачную смолу, которая называется бдолах.

ja.L: そしてマナ、それはコエンドロの種のようであり、その見た目は香りのよい樹脂の見た目のようであった。
ja.B: マナはコエンドロの種のようで、香りのよい樹脂のように見えた。
ja.R: マナは、小さなコリアンダーの種のような形をしていました。色は、白っぽく透き通った樹脂のようでした。

uk.L: А манна — вона [була] як коріандрове насіння, і її вигляд — як вигляд бделію.
uk.B: Манна була як коріандрове насіння, а на вигляд — як бделій.
uk.R: Манна була схожа на дрібне насіння коріандру. Вона мала колір блідої прозорої смоли, яку називають бделієм.

decisions.choice: coriander seed: a small, round, pale seed
decisions.reason: Coriander seeds are small and round. Exodus 16:31 gives the same comparison and adds that the manna was white and tasted like wafers made with honey.

decisions.choice: bdellium: a pale, translucent resin
decisions.reason: The word appears elsewhere only in Genesis 2:12, among the treasures of the land of Havilah. It is most likely a fragrant resin, yellowish and clear, though some take it to be a pearl or a precious stone. Either way, the manna had a pale, shining look.

decisions.choice: a pale, clear gum called bdellium
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the name and says what kind of thing it was, so that the comparison makes sense.

decisions.choice: "cilantro" for coriander
decisions.reason: "Cilantro" is the everyday name of the plant and its seed throughout the Spanish-speaking world; "coriandro" is the same plant but rare outside botany.

decisions.choice: "mbegu za giligilani" for coriander seed, as Exodus 16:31; "bedola" for bdellium, as Genesis 2:12
decisions.reason: "Giligilani" is the coriander seed used as a spice; "dania" (dhania) is the fresh leaf. The English keeps the name bdellium at every level, so Swahili keeps "bedola", the form used at Genesis 2:12, and Readable explains it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "베델리엄" for bdellium; Readable explains it as "연하고 맑은 나뭇진"
decisions.reason: Genesis 2:12 already has "베델리엄" at Literal in this translation; here the point is its pale, clear look, so Balanced keeps the name and Readable says what it was, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "nhựa thơm" for bdellium at every level
decisions.reason: Bdellium is a pale, sweet-smelling gum resin (meaning decision); "nhũ hương" means frankincense, a different resin, so every level says "nhựa thơm", as Genesis 2:12 does.

decisions.choice: o bdélio
decisions.reason: Genesis 2:12 has "bdélio" at Literal only, but here the English keeps the name at every level and Readable says what it is; Portuguese does the same, so the comparison with the resin's pale colour (m2) can be followed.

decisions.choice: "መና" (manna) and "ድንብላል" (coriander), as Exodus 16:31 in this translation; bdellium "ቤዶላሕ", as Genesis 2:12, with "ሙጫ" (resin) added at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The verse looks back to Exodus 16 and uses the same rare word as Genesis 2:12; Balanced and Readable say what bdellium is, since the name alone means nothing to most readers.

decisions.choice: "बदोलह" (bdellium)
decisions.reason: "बदोलह" is the name Genesis 2:12 uses (Literal); here it is kept at every level, since the comparison is with that named resin, and Readable says what kind of thing it is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "бдолах"
decisions.reason: Bdellium, a pale translucent resin, keeps its traditional Russian name "бдолах" (Genesis 2:12); Readable says what kind of thing it is.

decisions.choice: coriander "コエンドロ" (L, B), "コリアンダー" (R); bdellium "香りのよい樹脂" (L, B, as Genesis 2:12), "白っぽく透き通った樹脂" (R)
decisions.reason: The Exodus 16 and Genesis 2 forms; Readable describes the look, as the English Readable does.

source.text: שָׁטוּ֩ הָעָ֨ם וְלָֽקְט֜וּ וְטָחֲנ֣וּ בָרֵחַ֗יִם א֤וֹ דָכוּ֙ בַּמְּדֹכָ֔ה וּבִשְּׁלוּ֙ בַּפָּר֔וּר וְעָשׂ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ עֻג֑וֹת וְהָיָ֣ה טַעְמ֔וֹ כְּטַ֖עַם לְשַׁ֥ד הַשָּֽׁמֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: Went about the people and gathered and ground in the mill or pounded in the mortar, and boiled in the pot and made it cakes; and was its taste like [the] taste of cake of the oil.

en.L: The people went about and gathered [it] and ground [it] in the mill or pounded [it] in the mortar, and boiled [it] in the pot and made it [into] cakes; and its taste was like the taste of cakes [made with] oil.
en.B: The people went around gathering it. They ground it with millstones or crushed it in a mortar, then boiled it in a pot and made it into cakes. It tasted like pastry baked with olive oil.
en.R: The people walked around and picked it up. They ground it between stones or pounded it in a bowl. Then they cooked it in a pot and made flat loaves out of it. It tasted like bread made with olive oil.

es.L: El pueblo andaba de un lado a otro y [lo] recogía, y [lo] molía en el molino o [lo] machacaba en el mortero, y [lo] cocía en la olla y hacía con él tortas; y su sabor era como el sabor de tortas [hechas con] aceite.
es.B: El pueblo salía por todas partes a recogerlo. Lo molían con piedras de moler o lo machacaban en un mortero; luego lo cocían en una olla y hacían tortas con él. Sabía a pastel hecho con aceite de oliva.
es.R: La gente caminaba por ahí y lo recogía. Lo molían entre dos piedras o lo machacaban en un recipiente. Después lo cocinaban en una olla y hacían panes planos. Sabía a pan hecho con aceite de oliva.

fr.L: Le peuple allait çà et là et [la] ramassait, et [la] broyait à la meule ou [la] pilait au mortier, et [la] faisait cuire dans la marmite et en faisait des galettes ; et son goût était comme le goût de gâteaux [faits à] l’huile.
fr.B: Le peuple se dispersait pour la ramasser. On la broyait à la meule ou on l’écrasait au mortier, puis on la faisait cuire dans une marmite et on en faisait des galettes. Elle avait le goût d’une pâtisserie à l’huile d’olive.
fr.R: Les gens se promenaient et la ramassaient. Ils l’écrasaient entre deux pierres ou la pilaient dans un bol. Puis ils la faisaient cuire dans une marmite et en faisaient des pains plats. Elle avait le goût d’un pain fait avec de l’huile d’olive.

sw.L: Watu walizunguka huku na huko, wakakiokota, wakakisaga kwa jiwe la kusagia au wakakitwanga kinuni, wakakipika chunguni na kukifanya mikate; na ladha yake ilikuwa kama ladha ya mikate [iliyopikwa kwa] mafuta.
sw.B: Watu walizunguka wakikiokota. Walikisaga kwa mawe ya kusagia au kukitwanga kinuni, kisha wakakipika chunguni na kutengeneza maandazi. Ladha yake ilikuwa kama ya keki iliyookwa kwa mafuta ya zeituni.
sw.R: Watu walitembea huku na huko wakikiokota. Walikisaga kati ya mawe au kukitwanga katika kinu. Kisha walikipika katika chungu, wakatengeneza mikate bapa. Kilikuwa na ladha ya mkate uliopikwa kwa mafuta ya zeituni.

vi.L: Dân chúng đi khắp nơi và lượm [nó], và xay [nó] bằng cối xay hoặc giã [nó] trong cối, và nấu [nó] trong nồi và làm nó [thành] bánh; và mùi vị nó như mùi vị bánh [làm bằng] dầu.
vi.B: Dân chúng đi khắp nơi lượm ma-na, xay bằng cối đá hoặc giã trong cối, rồi nấu trong nồi và làm thành bánh. Ma-na có vị như bánh nướng bằng dầu ô-liu.
vi.R: Dân chúng đi quanh nhặt ma-na. Họ xay nó giữa hai hòn đá hoặc giã nó trong cối. Rồi họ nấu nó trong nồi và làm thành những cái bánh dẹt. Nó có vị như bánh làm bằng dầu ô-liu.

ko.L: 백성이 두루 다니며 [그것을] 거두어, 맷돌에 갈거나 절구에 찧어, 솥에 삶아 그것으로 둥근 빵을 만들었다. 그리고 그 맛은 기름 [섞은] 과자의 맛 같았다.
ko.B: 백성은 돌아다니며 그것을 거두어 맷돌에 갈거나 절구에 찧은 다음, 솥에 삶아서 둥근 빵을 만들었다. 그 맛은 올리브기름을 넣어 구운 과자 같았다.
ko.R: 사람들은 돌아다니며 그것을 주웠다. 그리고 돌 사이에 넣고 갈거나 그릇에 넣고 빻았다. 그다음에 솥에 넣어 익히고 납작한 빵을 만들었다. 그 맛은 올리브기름을 넣어 만든 빵 같았다.

pt.L: O povo andava ao redor e [o] recolhia, e [o] moía em moinhos ou [o] socava em pilão, e [o] cozinhava em panela e fazia dele bolos; e o seu sabor era como o sabor de bolos [feitos com] azeite.
pt.B: O povo saía para recolher o maná. Eles o moíam em moinhos de pedra ou o socavam num pilão; depois o cozinhavam numa panela e faziam bolos com ele. O seu gosto era de massa feita com azeite.
pt.R: As pessoas andavam por ali e recolhiam o maná. Elas o moíam entre duas pedras ou o socavam numa tigela. Depois o cozinhavam numa panela e faziam pães achatados com ele. Tinha gosto de pão feito com azeite.

am.L: ሕዝቡም ይዞሩ ነበር፤ ይሰበስቡትም ነበር፤ በወፍጮም ይፈጩት ወይም በሙቀጫ ይወቅጡት ነበር፤ በድስትም ይቀቅሉት ነበር፤ እንጎቻም ያደርጉት ነበር፤ ጣዕሙም በዘይት እንደ ተጋገረ እንጎቻ ጣዕም ነበረ።
am.B: ሕዝቡ እየዞሩ ይሰበስቡት ነበር። በወፍጮ ይፈጩት ወይም በሙቀጫ ይወቅጡት ነበር፤ ከዚያም በድስት ቀቅለው እንጎቻ ያደርጉት ነበር። ጣዕሙም በወይራ ዘይት የተጋገረ ቂጣ ይመስል ነበር።
am.R: ሕዝቡ እየዞሩ ይለቅሙት ነበር። በድንጋይ ይፈጩት ወይም በሙቀጫ ይወቅጡት ነበር። ከዚያም በድስት አብስለው ቂጣ ያደርጉት ነበር። ጣዕሙም በወይራ ዘይት የተሠራ ዳቦ ይመስል ነበር።

hi.L: लोग इधर-उधर जाकर [उसे] बटोरते, और चक्की में पीसते या ओखली में कूटते, और हाँडी में उबालते और उसकी रोटियाँ बनाते थे; और उसका स्वाद तेल [से बनी] रोटी के स्वाद जैसा था।
hi.B: लोग घूम-घूमकर उसे बटोरते थे। वे उसे चक्की में पीसते या ओखली में कूटते, फिर हाँडी में उबालकर उसकी रोटियाँ बनाते। उसका स्वाद जैतून के तेल में पके पकवान जैसा था।
hi.R: लोग इधर-उधर घूमकर उसे उठाते थे। वे उसे पत्थरों के बीच पीसते या कटोरे में कूटते। फिर वे उसे हाँडी में पकाकर उसकी चपटी रोटियाँ बनाते। उसका स्वाद जैतून के तेल से बनी रोटी जैसा था।

ru.L: Ходил народ и собирал [её], и молол [её] на жерновах или толок [её] в ступе, и варил [её] в котле, и делал из неё лепёшки; и вкус её был как вкус лепёшек на масле.
ru.B: Народ ходил и собирал её. Её мололи на жерновах или толкли в ступе, потом варили в котле и делали из неё лепёшки. На вкус она была как выпечка на оливковом масле.
ru.R: Люди ходили и подбирали её. Они мололи её между камнями или толкли в ступке. Потом варили её в котле и пекли из неё лепёшки. На вкус она была как хлеб на оливковом масле.

ja.L: 民は歩き回って[それを]集め、ひき臼でひくか、臼でついて、鍋で煮て、それを丸いパンにした。その味は、油で作った菓子の味のようであった。
ja.B: 民は歩き回ってそれを集め、ひき臼でひいたり、臼でついたりしてから、鍋で煮て、丸いパンにした。それは、オリーブ油を使って焼いた菓子のような味がした。
ja.R: 人々は歩き回って、それを拾い集めました。それを石でひいたり、うすでついたりしました。それから鍋で煮て、平たいパンを作りました。それは、オリーブ油を使ったパンのような味がしました。

uk.L: Люди ходили і збирали [її], і мололи [її] жорнами або товкли [її] в ступі, і варили [її] в горщику, і робили з неї коржі; а її смак був як смак коржів [на] оливі.
uk.B: Люди ходили і збирали її. Вони мололи її жорнами або товкли в ступі, тоді варили в горщику і робили з неї коржі. На смак вона була як печиво на оливковій олії.
uk.R: Люди ходили і збирали її. Вони мололи її між каменями або товкли в ступі. Тоді варили її в горщику і пекли з неї плескачі. На смак вона була як хліб на оливковій олії.

decisions.choice: cake of oil: something rich, made with olive oil
decisions.reason: The word translated "cake" is rare; it appears elsewhere only in Psalm 32:4, where it means moisture or freshness. Here it seems to mean a rich food made with oil, so the manna had a rich, oily taste. Exodus 16:31 compares it to wafers with honey.

decisions.choice: mill, mortar: household tools for grinding grain
decisions.reason: The mill was a pair of stones, a lower one and an upper one rubbed over it by hand. A mortar was a bowl in which grain was crushed with a pestle. The people treated manna like grain.

decisions.choice: went about ... gathered: what the people did every day
decisions.reason: The verbs describe a regular practice, what the people did each morning when manna came (Exodus 16:21).

decisions.choice: gathered [it], ground [it] ...
decisions.reason: Hebrew can leave the object of these verbs unsaid, since it is clear that the manna is meant. Literal brackets "it"; Balanced says it once at the start of each sentence.

decisions.choice: imperfect tense ("ramassait", "broyait") instead of the passé simple
decisions.reason: The verbs describe what the people did every morning (meaning decision m3), and French says a repeated action in the past with the imperfect, at every level.

decisions.choice: cake of oil: "油で作った菓子" (L), "オリーブ油を使って焼いた菓子" (B), "オリーブ油を使ったパン" (R)
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1 (uncertain): something rich made with olive oil.

source.text: וּבְרֶ֧דֶת הַטַּ֛ל עַל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה לָ֑יְלָה יֵרֵ֥ד הַמָּ֖ן עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And when came down the dew on the camp [at] night, came down the manna on it.

en.L: And when the dew came down on the camp [at] night, the manna came down on it.
en.B: Whenever the dew settled on the camp at night, the manna came down with it.
en.R: At night, when the dew fell on the camp, the manna fell along with it.

es.L: Y cuando descendía el rocío sobre el campamento de noche, descendía el maná sobre él.
es.B: Cada vez que el rocío caía de noche sobre el campamento, el maná bajaba con él.
es.R: De noche, cuando el rocío caía sobre el campamento, el maná caía junto con él.

fr.L: Et quand la rosée descendait sur le camp, la nuit, la manne descendait sur elle.
fr.B: Chaque fois que la rosée se déposait sur le camp pendant la nuit, la manne descendait avec elle.
fr.R: La nuit, quand la rosée tombait sur le camp, la manne tombait en même temps.

sw.L: Na umande uliposhuka juu ya kambi usiku, mana kilishuka juu yake.
sw.B: Kila mara umande uliposhuka kambini usiku, mana nacho kilishuka pamoja nao.
sw.R: Usiku, umande ulipoanguka juu ya kambi, mana nacho kilianguka pamoja nao.

vi.L: Và khi sương xuống trên trại quân ban đêm, ma-na xuống trên đó.
vi.B: Mỗi khi sương xuống trên trại quân ban đêm, ma-na cũng rơi xuống cùng với sương.
vi.R: Ban đêm, khi sương rơi xuống khu trại, ma-na cũng rơi xuống theo.

ko.L: 그리고 밤에 이슬이 진 위에 내리면, 만나가 그 위에 내렸다.
ko.B: 밤에 이슬이 진에 내릴 때마다 만나도 함께 내렸다.
ko.R: 밤에 이슬이 진에 내리면, 만나도 함께 내렸다.

pt.L: E quando o orvalho descia sobre o acampamento [de] noite, o maná descia sobre ele.
pt.B: Sempre que o orvalho caía sobre o acampamento durante a noite, o maná caía junto com ele.
pt.R: De noite, quando o orvalho caía sobre o acampamento, o maná caía junto.

am.L: ጤዛውም በሌሊት በሰፈሩ ላይ በወረደ ጊዜ መናው በእርሱ ላይ ይወርድ ነበር።
am.B: በሌሊት ጤዛው በሰፈሩ ላይ በወረደ ቁጥር መናውም ከእርሱ ጋር ይወርድ ነበር።
am.R: በሌሊት ጤዛ በሰፈሩ ላይ ሲወርድ መናውም አብሮት ይወርድ ነበር።

hi.L: और जब रात को छावनी पर ओस पड़ती, तब उस पर मन्ना भी उतरता था।
hi.B: जब भी रात को छावनी पर ओस पड़ती, तब उसके साथ मन्ना भी गिरता था।
hi.R: रात को, जब छावनी पर ओस पड़ती, तब उसके साथ मन्ना भी गिरता था।

ru.L: И когда сходила роса на стан ночью, сходила на него манна.
ru.B: Всякий раз, когда ночью на стан выпадала роса, вместе с ней выпадала и манна.
ru.R: Ночью, когда на лагерь выпадала роса, вместе с ней выпадала и манна.

ja.L: そして夜、露が宿営の上に降りると、マナがその上に降りた。
ja.B: 夜、露が宿営の上に降りるたびに、マナもそれと一緒に降りた。
ja.R: 夜になって、露が宿営に降りると、マナも一緒に降りて来ました。

uk.L: І коли роса спадала на табір уночі, спадала на нього манна.
uk.B: Щоразу, коли вночі на табір спадала роса, разом із нею спадала й манна.
uk.R: Уночі, коли на табір падала роса, разом із нею падала манна.

decisions.choice: came down: every night, again and again
decisions.reason: The verb describes what happened regularly. The manna came with the dew each night, so it was there in the morning when the dew lifted (Exodus 16:13-14).

decisions.choice: on it: on the dew, or with it on the camp
decisions.reason: The word can mean "on it" or "with it". Exodus 16:13-14 shows the dew lying around the camp and the manna left on the ground when the dew lifted, so the manna lay with or on the dew.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־הָעָ֗ם בֹּכֶה֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔יו אִ֖ישׁ לְפֶ֣תַח אָהֳל֑וֹ וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ מְאֹ֔ד וּבְעֵינֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֖ה רָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard Moses the people weeping by its clans, each at [the] entrance of his tent; and burned [the] anger of Yahweh greatly, and in [the] eyes of Moses [it was] evil.

en.L: And Moses heard the people weeping by their clans, each at the entrance of his tent; and the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned greatly, and in the eyes of Moses [it was] evil.
en.B: Moses heard the people weeping, family by family, everyone at the entrance of their tent. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} became very angry, and Moses was deeply troubled.
en.R: Moses heard the people crying in every family. Each person was standing in the doorway of their tent and crying. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} became very angry, and Moses was very upset too.

es.L: Y oyó Moisés al pueblo que lloraba por sus clanes, cada uno a la entrada de su tienda; y se encendió sobremanera la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y a los ojos de Moisés [fue] malo.
es.B: Moisés oyó llorar al pueblo, familia por familia, cada uno a la entrada de su tienda. La ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se encendió mucho, y Moisés se sintió muy afligido.
es.R: Moisés oyó a la gente llorar en todas las familias. Cada uno estaba a la puerta de su tienda, llorando. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó muchísimo, y Moisés también estaba muy disgustado.

fr.L: Et Moïse entendit le peuple pleurer selon ses clans, chacun à l’entrée de sa tente ; et la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma fortement, et aux yeux de Moïse [ce fut] mal.
fr.B: Moïse entendit le peuple pleurer, famille par famille, chacun à l’entrée de sa tente. La colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma violemment, et Moïse en fut profondément troublé.
fr.R: Moïse a entendu les gens pleurer dans toutes les familles. Chacun se tenait à l’entrée de sa tente et pleurait. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis très en colère, et Moïse aussi était très contrarié.

sw.L: Na Musa akawasikia watu wakilia kwa koo zao, kila mtu mlangoni pa hema lake; na hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka sana, na machoni mwa Musa [jambo hilo lilikuwa] baya.
sw.B: Musa aliwasikia watu wakilia, jamaa kwa jamaa, kila mmoja mlangoni pa hema lake. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akakasirika sana, naye Musa akahuzunika mno.
sw.R: Musa aliwasikia watu wakilia katika kila jamaa. Kila mtu alikuwa amesimama mlangoni pa hema lake akilia. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akakasirika sana, naye Musa akasikitika sana pia.

vi.L: Và Môi-se nghe dân chúng khóc lóc theo từng gia tộc, mỗi người tại cửa lều mình; và cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bừng lên dữ dội, và trong mắt Môi-se [điều ấy là] xấu.
vi.B: Môi-se nghe dân chúng khóc lóc, từng gia đình một, mỗi người tại cửa lều mình. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giận, và Môi-se cũng rất phiền lòng.
vi.R: Môi-se nghe dân chúng khóc lóc trong mọi gia đình. Ai nấy đều đứng ở cửa lều mình mà khóc. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giận, và Môi-se cũng rất buồn bực.

ko.L: 그리고 모세는 백성이 그들의 가문별로, 각 사람이 자기 장막 입구에서 우는 것을 들었다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 크게 타올랐고, 모세의 눈에도 [그것이] 악하였다.
ko.B: 모세는 백성이 가문마다, 저마다 자기 장막 입구에서 우는 소리를 들었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 몹시 진노하셨고, 모세도 마음이 몹시 괴로웠다.
ko.R: 모세는 집집마다 사람들이 우는 소리를 들었다. 저마다 자기 장막 입구에 서서 울고 있었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 몹시 화가 나셨고, 모세도 몹시 속이 상했다.

pt.L: E Moisés ouviu o povo chorando segundo os seus clãs, cada um à entrada da sua tenda; e a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se acendeu muito, e aos olhos de Moisés [isso era] mau.
pt.B: Moisés ouviu o povo chorando, família por família, cada um à entrada da sua tenda. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ficou muito irado, e Moisés ficou profundamente aflito.
pt.R: Moisés ouviu o povo chorando em todas as famílias. Cada pessoa estava na entrada da sua tenda, chorando. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ficou muito irado, e Moisés também ficou muito aborrecido.

am.L: ሙሴም ሕዝቡ በየወገናቸው፣ እያንዳንዱ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ፣ ሲያለቅሱ ሰማ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቁጣም እጅግ ነደደ፤ በሙሴም ዓይን ክፉ [ነበረ]።
am.B: ሙሴ ሕዝቡ በየቤተሰቡ፣ እያንዳንዱ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ሆኖ፣ ሲያለቅስ ሰማ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እጅግ ተቆጣ፤ ሙሴም እጅግ ተጨነቀ።
am.R: ሙሴ ሕዝቡ በየቤተሰቡ ሲያለቅስ ሰማ። እያንዳንዱ ሰው በድንኳኑ በር ቆሞ ያለቅስ ነበር። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በጣም ተቆጣ፤ ሙሴም ደግሞ በጣም ተበሳጨ።

hi.L: और मूसा ने लोगों को अपने-अपने कुलों के अनुसार, हर एक को अपने तंबू के द्वार पर, रोते सुना; और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का क्रोध बहुत भड़का, और मूसा की दृष्टि में [यह] बुरा [था]।
hi.B: मूसा ने सुना कि लोग कुल-कुल करके रो रहे हैं, हर कोई अपने तंबू के द्वार पर। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का क्रोध बहुत भड़क उठा, और मूसा भी बहुत दुखी हुआ।
hi.R: मूसा ने हर परिवार में लोगों को रोते सुना। हर कोई अपने तंबू के द्वार पर खड़ा होकर रो रहा था। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} बहुत क्रोधित हुए, और मूसा भी बहुत परेशान हुआ।

ru.L: И услышал Моисей, как народ плачет по своим родам, каждый у входа в свой шатёр; и сильно воспылал гнев {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и в глазах Моисея [это было] худо.
ru.B: Моисей слышал, как плачет народ, семья за семьёй, каждый у входа в свой шатёр. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сильно разгневался, и Моисею было очень тяжело.
ru.R: Моисей слышал, как плачут во всех семьях. Каждый стоял у входа в свой шатёр и плакал. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сильно разгневался, и Моисей тоже был очень огорчён.

ja.L: そしてモーセは、民がその氏族ごとに、それぞれ自分の天幕の入り口で泣いているのを聞いた。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の怒りは激しく燃え、モーセの目にも[それは]悪いことであった。
ja.B: モーセは、民が家族ごとに、それぞれ自分の天幕の入り口で泣いているのを聞いた。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は激しく怒られ、モーセも深く心を痛めた。
ja.R: モーセは、どの家族の人々も泣いているのを聞きました。みな、自分のテントの入り口に立って泣いていたのです。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はとても怒られました。モーセも、たいへんいやな気持ちになりました。

uk.L: І почув Мойсей, як народ плакав за своїми родами, кожен біля входу свого намету; і дуже запалав гнів {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і в очах Мойсея [це було] зле.
uk.B: Мойсей чув, як народ плакав, рід за родом, кожен біля входу свого намету. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дуже розгнівався, і Мойсей був глибоко засмучений.
uk.R: Мойсей чув, як плакали люди в кожній родині. Кожен стояв біля входу свого намету і плакав. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дуже розгнівався, і Мойсей теж був дуже засмучений.

decisions.choice: by their clans, each at the entrance of his tent: the weeping went through the whole camp
decisions.reason: Israel camped by tribes and clans (2:34). The weeping was not a few voices but family after family, each at its own tent, out in the open where everyone could hear.

decisions.choice: in the eyes of Moses it was evil: Moses was displeased and distressed
decisions.reason: "Evil in someone's eyes" means that a person sees something as bad and is upset by it. It can mean that Moses was displeased with the people, or that the whole situation, their weeping and God's anger, distressed him. His prayer in verses 11-15 shows his distress.

decisions.choice: everyone at the entrance of their tent
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "each" (literally "a man") here means each person, as the whole people was weeping. Balanced and Readable use "everyone" and "each person", which take no gender setting; Literal keeps "each ... his".

decisions.choice: "हर एक", "हर कोई" (no gender span)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "each" (literally "a man") means each person here; Hindi "हर एक" and "हर कोई" already include everyone, and "अपने" does not mark gender, so the Hindi needs no span.

decisions.choice: in the eyes of Moses it was evil: "モーセの目にも[それは]悪いことであった" (L), "深く心を痛めた" (B), "いやな気持ちになりました" (R)
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m2: Moses was displeased and distressed; Literal keeps the idiom.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־יְהוָ֗ה לָמָ֤ה הֲרֵעֹ֨תָ֙ לְעַבְדֶּ֔ךָ וְלָ֛מָּה לֹא־מָצָ֥תִי חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ לָשׂ֗וּם אֶת־מַשָּׂ֛א כָּל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Moses to Yahweh, why have you done evil to your slave? And why not have I found favor in your eyes, to put [the] burden of all the people the this on me?

en.L: And Moses said to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "Why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} done evil to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} slave? And why have I not found favor in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes, that [{{deity_pronoun:you|You}}] put the burden of all this people on me?
en.B: Moses said to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "Why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought this trouble on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant? Why do I find no favor with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} load me with the burden of this whole people?
en.R: Moses said to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "Why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made things so hard for me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant? Why are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not pleased with me? You have made me responsible for all these people, and it is too heavy a load!

es.L: Y dijo Moisés {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¿Por qué has hecho mal a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} esclavo? ¿Y por qué no he hallado gracia ante {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos, para que pongas sobre mí la carga de todo este pueblo?
es.B: Moisés dijo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¿Por qué has traído este mal sobre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo? ¿Por qué no hallo favor ante {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, que me cargas con el peso de todo este pueblo?
es.R: Moisés le dijo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¿Por qué me has hecho las cosas tan difíciles a mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo? ¿Por qué no estás contento conmigo? Me has hecho responsable de todo este pueblo, ¡y es una carga demasiado pesada!

fr.L: Et Moïse dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Pourquoi as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fait du mal à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} esclave ? Et pourquoi n’ai-je pas trouvé grâce à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux, pour que [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}] mettes sur moi le fardeau de tout ce peuple ?
fr.B: Moïse dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Pourquoi as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} attiré ce malheur sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ? Pourquoi n’ai-je pas trouvé faveur auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me charges du fardeau de tout ce peuple ?
fr.R: Moïse a dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Pourquoi m’as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rendu la vie si dure, à moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ? Pourquoi n’es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pas content de moi ? Tu m’as rendu responsable de tout ce peuple, et c’est une charge trop lourde !

sw.L: Na Musa akamwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Kwa nini umemtendea mabaya mtumwa {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}? Na kwa nini sikupata kibali machoni {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}}, hata [ukaweka] juu yangu mzigo wa watu hawa wote?
sw.B: Musa alimwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Kwa nini umeleta taabu hii juu ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}? Kwa nini sipati kibali mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, hata unanitwika mzigo wa watu hawa wote?
sw.R: Musa alimwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Kwa nini umenifanyia mambo kuwa magumu hivi, mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}? Kwa nini hupendezwi nami? Umenipa jukumu la kuwatunza watu hawa wote, nao ni mzigo mzito mno!

vi.L: Và Môi-se thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm điều xấu cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Và sao con không được ơn trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mà [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] đặt gánh nặng của cả dân này trên con?
vi.B: Môi-se thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại gây khốn khổ cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như vậy? Sao con không được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đoái thương, mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại chất trên con gánh nặng của cả dân này?
vi.R: Môi-se thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khổ sở như vậy? Sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không hài lòng về con? Ngài đã bắt con phải lo cho cả dân này, và gánh nặng ấy quá sức con!

ko.L: 그리고 모세가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 말하였다. "어찌하여 주님께서 주님의 종에게 악을 행하셨습니까? 그리고 어찌하여 제가 주님의 눈에 은혜를 입지 못하여, 주님께서 이 모든 백성의 짐을 제게 지우십니까?
ko.B: 모세가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 아뢰었다. "어찌하여 주님의 종에게 이런 괴로움을 주십니까? 어찌하여 제가 주님께 은혜를 입지 못하여, 주님께서 이 온 백성의 짐을 제게 지우십니까?
ko.R: 모세가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 말씀드렸다. "왜 주님의 종인 저를 이렇게 힘들게 하십니까? 왜 저를 좋게 보아 주지 않으십니까? 주님께서는 이 모든 백성을 저에게 맡기셨습니다. 그 짐이 너무 무겁습니다!

pt.L: E Moisés disse {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Por que fizeste mal ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} escravo? E por que não achei favor aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} olhos, para [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}] pores sobre mim o peso de todo este povo?
pt.B: Moisés disse {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Por que trouxeste este mal sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo? Por que não encontro favor diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ponhas sobre mim o peso de todo este povo?
pt.R: Moisés disse {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Por que tornaste as coisas tão difíceis para mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo? Por que não estás contente comigo? Tu me fizeste responsável por todo este povo, e o peso é grande demais!

am.L: ሙሴም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አለው፦ «ባሪያህን ስለ ምን ክፉ አደረግህበት? የዚህን ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሸክም በእኔ ላይ [ትጭን] ዘንድ በፊትህ ስለ ምን ሞገስ አላገኘሁም?
am.B: ሙሴ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እንዲህ አለው፦ «በአገልጋይህ ላይ ይህን መከራ ለምን አመጣህ? የዚህን ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሸክም በእኔ ላይ እስክትጭን ድረስ በፊትህ ሞገስ ያጣሁት ለምንድን ነው?
am.R: ሙሴ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እንዲህ አለው፦ «እኔን አገልጋይህን ይህን ያህል ለምን አስቸገርከኝ? ለምን በእኔ ደስ አላለህም? የዚህን ሁሉ ሕዝብ ኃላፊነት በእኔ ላይ ጫንክ፤ ሸክሙም እጅግ ከብዶኛል!

hi.L: और मूसा ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से कहा, "तूने अपने दास के साथ बुराई क्यों की? और मैंने तेरी दृष्टि में अनुग्रह क्यों नहीं पाया, कि [तूने] इन सब लोगों का बोझ मुझ पर डाल दिया?
hi.B: मूसा ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से कहा, "तूने अपने दास पर यह विपत्ति क्यों डाली? मैंने तेरी कृपादृष्टि क्यों नहीं पाई, कि तूने इन सारे लोगों का बोझ मुझ पर लाद दिया?
hi.R: मूसा ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से कहा, "तूने मेरे लिए, अपने दास के लिए, सब कुछ इतना कठिन क्यों कर दिया? तू मुझसे प्रसन्न क्यों नहीं है? तूने इन सब लोगों की ज़िम्मेदारी मुझ पर डाल दी है, और यह बोझ बहुत भारी है!

ru.L: И сказал Моисей {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}: «Зачем {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал худо {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} рабу? И почему я не нашёл благоволения в {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} глазах, что [{{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}] возложил бремя всего этого народа на меня?
ru.B: Моисей сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}: «Зачем {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} навлёк такую беду на {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} раба? Почему я не нахожу у {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} благоволения, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} взвалил на меня бремя всего этого народа?
ru.R: Моисей сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}: «Зачем {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} так мучаешь меня, {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} раба? Почему {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} недоволен мной? Ты сделал меня ответственным за весь этот народ, а это слишком тяжёлая ноша!

ja.L: そしてモーセは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に言った。「なぜ、あなたはしもべに悪いことをなさったのですか？なぜ、わたしはあなたの目に好意を得られず、この民全体の重荷をわたしの上に負わされるのですか？
ja.B: モーセは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に言った。「なぜ、あなたはしもべにこのような苦しみをお与えになるのですか？なぜ、わたしはあなたの好意を得られず、この民全体の重荷を負わされるのですか？
ja.R: モーセは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に言いました。「なぜ、あなたのしもべであるわたしを、こんなに苦しめるのですか？なぜ、わたしを喜んでくださらないのですか？あなたは、この民全部の世話をわたしにさせておられます。それはあまりにも重い荷物です。

uk.L: І сказав Мойсей {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}: «Навіщо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вчинив зле {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} рабові? І чому я не знайшов ласки в {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} очах, що [{{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}] поклав тягар усього цього народу на мене?
